description: This file provides a comprehensive interface for extracting text and structured data from various file formats including .txt, .pdf, .docx, .xlsx, and .json. It includes functions for parsing, summarizing, and converting content into human-readable or structured JSON formats, with attention to efficiency and robustness.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Optional[str]] extract_text_from_bytes(filename: str, content: bytes)
methods.description: Main interface to extract readable text from various file formats based on filename extension.

methods.name: str _extract_txt(content: bytes)
methods.description: Decode content as UTF-8 ignoring errors.

methods.name: str _extract_pdf(content: bytes)
methods.description: Extract text from a PDF byte stream using pdfminer.six.

methods.name: str _extract_docx(content: bytes)
methods.description: Extract text from a DOCX byte stream using python-docx, including paragraphs and table contents.

methods.name: str _extract_xlsx(content: bytes)
methods.description: Extract structured context from XLSX files using openpyxl, including headers, data rows, unique values, JSON sample, and TSV preview while respecting file size limits.

methods.name: str _extract_json(content: bytes)
methods.description: Parse JSON content, and generate summaries for arrays and objects, producing structured reports with samples, keys, and nested data.

methods.name: str _json_array_of_objects_summary( arr: List[Any], title: str = "[JSON Array of objects]", json_sample_rows_env: str = "FILE_EXTRACT_JSON_SAMPLE_ROWS", tsv_preview_rows_env: str = "FILE_EXTRACT_JSON_TSV_PREVIEW_ROWS", unique_limit_env: str = "FILE_EXTRACT_JSON_UNIQUE_LIMIT", scan_rows_env: str = "FILE_EXTRACT_JSON_SCAN_ROWS", )
methods.description: Generate a summary block for an array of JSON objects including columns, unique values, samples, and TSV preview.

methods.name: List[str] _flatten_keys(d: Dict[str, Any], parent: str = "", sep: str = ".", depth: int = 0, max_depth: int = 2)
methods.description: Flatten nested JSON object keys up to specified depth using dot notation.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _flatten_to_record(obj: Dict[str, Any], max_depth: int = 2, max_str_len: int = 300)
methods.description: Flatten a JSON object into a single-level dict with dot notation keys, coercing values for JSON serialization.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _row_to_record(headers: List[str], row_vals: List[Any])
methods.description: Map a list of row values to a dict using specified headers, coercing values for JSON serialization.

methods.name: str _record_to_tsv(headers: List[str], record: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Convert a record dictionary into a TSV line respecting header order.

methods.name: None _update_uniques(uniques: Dict[str, set], headers: List[str], record: Dict[str, Any], limit: int)
methods.description: Update per-column sets of distinct string values, maintaining a limit.

methods.name: str summarize_text_preview(text: str, max_chars: int = 500)
methods.description: Create a single-line, truncated preview of extracted text content for UI display.

ctags.signature: (d: Dict[str, Any], parent: str = "", sep: str = ".", depth: int = 0, max_depth: int = 2)
